opportunities.name: GitHub developer lead research and email
opportunities.description: Look up a GitHub user, collect follower count, top repo (stars, language) and latest blog post, then write a lead email for a given role to hiring@example.com.
steps: Open github.com and click the Search box
Type the username and submit
Open the Users filter in the results
Open the matching user's profile
Note follower count, pinned/top repo, its star count and language
Open the top repo to confirm stars and language
Find the user's latest blog post (from the profile's website link)
Open the email compose page
Set To = hiring@example.com
Set Subject = 'Lead for <role>: <username>'
Set Body = '<username>: <followers> followers, top repo <repo> (<stars> stars, <language>), latest post: <post title>.'
Send, or discard the draft

instances.values: karpathy; ML Research Engineer; 226k followers, nanoGPT 63.8k stars Python, post: microgpt
gaearon; Staff Frontend Engineer; 94k followers, react/react 251k stars JavaScript, post: How I Vibed a Proof of Conway's Conjecture
simonw (profile research only; no email seen in the recording)

opportunities.name: Person-to-company Wayback snapshot lookup
opportunities.description: Look up a person on Wikipedia to find a key year (e.g. the year they became CEO), then open the related website on the Wayback Machine for that year and save the headline in Notes.
steps: Open Wikipedia and search for the person's name
Read the article to find the key year and organization/website
Open web.archive.org (Wayback Machine)
Enter the website URL and submit
Select the year on the calendar timeline and open a snapshot
Read the main headline
Open Notes and add '<site> in <year>: <headline>'

instances.values: Satya Nadella -> microsoft.com, 2014 -> 'Meet the Nokia Lumia 1520 and Lumia 1020'
Tim Berners-Lee -> Wayback Machine opened (site/year not seen in the recording)

opportunities.name: Nearest place + route + neighborhood note
opportunities.description: For a given address, find the nearest place of a given type on OpenStreetMap, get directions and travel time, look up the neighborhood on Wikipedia, and save a summary note.
steps: Open openstreetmap.org and search '<place type> near <address>'
Open the top Nominatim result and note its name and address
Click Directions, set From = address and To = the place found
Read the distance and travel time
Search Wikipedia for the neighborhood and copy its one-line description
Open Notes and add '<address>: nearest <place type> <name>, <distance>, <time>. <Neighborhood>: <description>'

instances.values: 350 5th Ave, New York; library -> 96th Street Library, 5.5 km, 74 min; Midtown Manhattan (interrupted by other tasks; the route finished at 802)
coffee near Union Square (Nominatim returned no results)
